title: agy-bridge Resilience & Repin Implementation Plan
summary: Implementation plan hardening agy-bridge's model fetch, launcher pin verification, and agy-setup output against hangs and stale pins.
notes: Type assigned via manifest override, not inferred. Work described here is already committed (13 commits on fix/agy-bridge-resilience). Document is known to be partially superseded by shipped code: it asserts two agy call sites where four exist, contains wrong test-count expectations, and prescribes a sed range fix that proved incomplete during implementation. Where this document and current code disagree, the code is authoritative -- downstream synthesis should not treat every claim here as current design intent.
